sections.title: Identity & Placement
sections.description: Naming, description, and target VPC attachment

fields.label: Security Group Name

validation.error_message: 1 to 255 alphanumeric characters, underscores, dashes, or periods.

fields.why: Human-readable identifier for the security group in the AWS account.
fields.impact: Changing the security group name forces resource re-creation.

fields.label: Description
fields.why: Describes the security group's intended purpose and firewall rules.
fields.impact: Forces resource re-creation if modified post-creation.

fields.label: VPC ID
fields.why: Binds this firewall group exclusively to a specific Virtual Private Cloud.
fields.impact: Changing VPC ID forces destruction and re-creation of the security group.
